scope: Official SQLite documentation and version-pinned SQLite source; examples are independently authored

claims.claim: FTS5 is a virtual table module providing full-text search
unicode61 treats each contiguous run of token characters as one token; it does not implement Chinese dictionary segmentation
claims.notes: Inferred from unicode61 token-character rules and confirmed by the fts5vocab probe in examples/21_tokenizer_probe.py.

claims.claim: FTS5 writes transaction segments as B-trees; queries visit each segment and merge results
automerge work is normally performed within INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE operations, not by a background thread
optimize merges component B-trees and can take a long time; merge can divide work into steps
bm25 scores rank better matches with numerically lower values; rank defaults to bm25 and may be faster for ORDER BY
external content tables require application synchronization; rebuild recreates the index from the content table
